final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS event_avg FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM budget), above_overall AS (SELECT e.link_to_event, e.event_avg, e.event_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM event_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND e.event_avg > o.overall_avg), above_average AS (SELECT AVG(event_avg) AS avg_event_avg FROM above_overall) SELECT a.link_to_event, a.event_avg, a.difference, a.event_avg - b.avg_event_avg AS difference_from_above_average FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN above_average AS b WHERE b.avg_event_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference_from_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
